title: Yard and Foundation Drainage Kenmore WA — French Drains, Downspout Tightlines, Grading and Where the Water Can Go
description: A Kenmore homeowner's guide to yard and foundation drainage: grading away from the house, French and curtain drains, downspout tightlines and catch basins, when Kenmore's land alteration and drainage rules apply, where the water is allowed to go, and how to vet a drainage contractor.
outline: Why drainage questions come up so often in Kenmore

Next steps for a wet Kenmore yard
search_intent: A Kenmore homeowner with a soggy yard or water at the foundation wants to know how to fix grading, downspouts and French or curtain drains, when Kenmore's land alteration and surface water rules apply, where the water may legally discharge, and how to vet a drainage contractor.
local_angles: KMC 15.20.120 adopts 2021 IRC with 51-51 WAC amendments (R401/R405 not amended)

KMC 15.25.160 ESC always; concentrated water to natural watercourse/public storm drain/approved means
